_README: Label id -> structure name for TotalSegmentator v2's 'head_muscles' task, plus the reviewed mapping onto atlas entities.
A KEY, not data: it contains no anatomy and no geometry. Entries with atlas_id null are decisions NOT to map, each with its reason.
source: Wasserthal J et al., TotalSegmentator (Radiology: AI 2023, doi:10.1148/ryai.230024); class map transcribed from totalsegmentator/map_to_binary.py, v2.18.0, Apache-2.0. Task listed in the project README under 'Openly available for any usage (Apache-2.0 license)'.

tongue.note: One mask over a group the atlas carries as separate entities; the ATLAS is finer than this task resolves, which no mapping can fix (same situation as 'autochthon' in the total task). Atlas: genioglossus, hyoglossus, styloglossus, palatoglossus and the intrinsic tongue muscles.
